meta.title: Patient Follow-up Workflow
meta.description: A fictional proposal for a clearer patient follow-up process.

hero.title: Make every patient follow-up visible
hero.summary: Northwind Dental needs one dependable place to see which patients need a response, what happened last, and who owns the next action.

sections.heading: The handoff disappears between systems
sections.body: A patient can leave a message, reply to a reminder, or ask a question at the front desk. The team has no shared queue that connects those moments, so follow-up depends on memory.
bullets: Ownership is unclear after a handoff
Managers cannot spot an aging request early

sections.heading: A small queue with clear ownership
sections.body: The workflow collects follow-up requests in one board, assigns an owner, and records the next action. A daily exception view highlights anything that has waited too long.
bullets: One intake path for every follow-up request
Named owner and next action on every item
Daily exception list for unresolved requests

sections.heading: Build, test, and hand off
sections.body: We will map the current handoff, configure the workflow, test it with fictional records, and train the team on the operating checklist.

cta.heading: Ready for a controlled pilot
cta.body: Approval authorizes the team to schedule discovery and turn this proposal into a final implementation plan. No payment is collected on this page.

acceptance.heading: Approve the next step
acceptance.statement: By signing, you confirm that the proposal reflects the workflow you want evaluated during discovery.
acceptance.checkboxLabel: I have reviewed this fictional proposal and approve the discovery step.
